cap: One question, two answers. The smaller crowd wins.
vo: This is Odd One In, a minority game on NEAR. One question, two answers. Everyone picks in secret, and the smaller crowd wins.

cap: House players with their own wallets, and habits you can read
vo: You're not guessing blind. The regulars at the table are house players with their own wallets, and each one has a public habit. Tap one to see which way they lean, and why.

cap: The whole loop in ten seconds, nothing on chain
vo: They keep to that habit four rounds in five. A practice round shows the whole game in ten seconds.

cap: No wallet: a free testnet account, sealed on chain in seconds
vo: For a real round, tap an answer and seal it. There's no wallet to connect. The app makes a free testnet account and seals your pick on chain.

cap: The regulars join. Nobody can see anyone's side.
vo: The regulars join with sealed picks of their own. Nobody can see anyone's side, not even the contract owner.

cap: Next round, every pick opens and the smaller crowd is ringed
vo: In the next round, the picks open. Each one walks to its side, and the smaller crowd gets the ring.

cap: The contract pays the smaller side
vo: One round later the contract pays the smaller side, and your result arrives.

cap: Wins, losses, and how often each regular kept to habit
vo: Every regular builds a record: wins, losses, and how often they kept to their habit. And any finished round can be replayed.

cap: npm run judge rechecks every claim against the live contract
vo: None of this asks for trust. One command rechecks every claim against the live contract, and recomputes every lean.
Odd One In. Live on NEAR testnet. Go be the odd one in.
